answer.book: A single treatise by Ubbo Emmius (title page dated 1646), 'Agro Frisiae inter Amasum et Lavicam fl. deque urbe Groninga', built as a dedication, a table of contents and testimonials on Emmius, then thirteen chapters, then an appendix of monastery and village lists, consul and hovetmanni series, deputies, rectors and curators.
